row_added_fields.matchingView: string from actual matching_view_v2; current pure content preview has no channel namespace so it equals the exact raw text
row_added_fields.conditions: ConditionMatchTraceV2[] in source order, every declared condition

condition_shape.matched: boolean|null: selector outcome, null if family not applicable
condition_shape.applied: boolean: actual unique effective condition, never adoption/save authority

nullable_rules: layout failure -> layout=false,tail=null,all atoms=null; literal-tail failure -> layout=true,tail=false,all atoms=null
prerequisites passed -> evaluate every AND atom, including after a failed atom; false is a real predicate failure, null is not evaluated
only applied=true corresponds to the actual returned matchedConditionId; matching a family never fabricates a condition adoption
error_semantics: bad content/layout reference remains original validation Err
runtime overlap remains Err model_condition_overlap + exact conditionIds, never a green traced result

trace_budget.formula: rows * (1 + sum(condition atom count + 1 + (2 if declared layout else 0)))

schema_generation: Rust schemars 0.8.22 schema_for!(ConditionPreview), with test-only wire_output_schema correcting exactly existing FieldOriginV2 condition_id/template_id properties+required names to actual serde conditionId/templateId. No variant/reference/reason/oneOf relaxed; production serializer/config fields untouched.
read_only: preview command is pure in-memory; no root/home/runtime/service/vault arguments or IO. Sample generator uses frozen synthetic content and actual Rust function.
frontend_instruction: Consume real bool|null and preconditions; never coerce skipped null to false/success, never synthesize matchingView or atom reasons. Keep errors in original structured issue flow. Use actual_function_cases as backend evidence, not hand-declared renderer fixtures.
